residency.title: Data residency

credits.title: Credits
credits.hint: Generation is priced before it runs; the storyboard is reviewable before any render spend.

audit.title: Audit log

reports.noExportsHint: Build a pack for a period to get a signed download link.

newSource.title: Pick a source

styleHints.motion: Generated scenes with narration. Best for processes.

publish.audienceHint: Groups that receive this reel in their daily minute.

topics.peopleHint: Import from Jisr or Bayzat, upload a CSV with a preview, or invite one person.

delivery.subtitle: When reels arrive. Shift windows, prayer and Ramadan awareness, and the daily cadence.

gentle.name: Gentle
gentle.hint: The daily minute only, ordered by the engine.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.hint: The minute, then a short practice with breaks.

intense.name: Intense
intense.hint: Longer practice, stronger interest and colleague signals.

maximum.name: Maximum

facts.reminders: {count, plural, =0 {No reminders} one {# reminder a day} other {# reminders a day}}

routing.hint: Writers draft scripts, questions and translations. TypeSafe Jev checks each draft and never writes.

routing.roleMatchingHint: Jev judges how relevant each published reel is to each job title. New people start from their role; their own choices take over within a few weeks.
routing.tagCheck: Connect new reels to your existing subjects
routing.tagCheckHint: Jev keeps the writer's subject tags it agrees with and adds your company's tags that fit, so related reels find each other.
